name: Glimmerfruit
desc:
The peculiar fruit borne by plants which were born under the influence of the Pillar of Embla. They are suffused with sufficient kuuvahki energy.
By absorbing and throwing a Glimmerfruit, you can consume it to release a single powerful kuuvahki current.
